space.name: Space
space.tagline: Enterprise-grade ERPNext hosting — provisioned in minutes, operated to production standards.
space.description: Space is ZatGo's hosting control plane for ERPNext: provision sites on demand, enforce capacity and quotas per server, manage backups and subscriptions, and give every customer a governed path from trial to production — all from a single, auditable console.

modules.name: Self-serve ERPNext sites
modules.summary: Customers create and manage their own ERPNext sites from a guided wizard — no ops ticket required.

modules.name: Hosting pools & quotas
modules.summary: Track real disk, RAM, and CPU capacity per server, with quotas enforced per site and per plan.

modules.name: Customer & subscription management
modules.summary: Every site is tied to a real customer account and plan, with trials, upgrades, and billing status tracked centrally.

modules.name: Bench manager & backups
modules.summary: Fetch apps from git, install or remove them per site, migrate, and schedule backups — all from the admin console.

modules.name: Multi-region ready
modules.summary: Place sites by region, cluster, and server affinity as the fleet grows across providers.

faq.question: What is Space?
faq.answer: Space is ZatGo's hosting platform for ERPNext. It handles server capacity, site provisioning, plans, and customer accounts, so you get a working ERPNext site without managing infrastructure yourself.

faq.question: Can I try it for free?
faq.answer: Yes — sign up and start a free trial site in minutes from the customer portal. No credit card required to explore the platform.

faq.question: Who is Space for?
faq.answer: Teams who want ERPNext without running their own servers, and operators who need a control plane to manage many customer sites, plans, and backups from one place.

erpnext.name: ZatGo ERP
erpnext.tagline: Enterprise ERP — finance, supply chain, and HR on a single, secure platform.
erpnext.description: ZatGo ERP, built on ERPNext, is the enterprise resource planning system behind every ZatGo deployment: accounting, sales and purchasing, inventory and manufacturing, projects, and HR, unified in a single auditable system of record. It runs on Space, ZatGo's hosting platform, with provisioning, monitoring, and backups handled automatically.

modules.name: Financial accounting & compliance
modules.summary: General ledger, multi-currency accounting, tax compliance, and audit-ready financial reporting.

modules.name: Sales, purchasing & supply chain
modules.summary: End-to-end quote-to-cash and procure-to-pay cycles with full traceability.

modules.name: Inventory & manufacturing
modules.summary: Multi-warehouse stock control, bills of materials, and production planning.

modules.name: HR, payroll & workforce management
modules.summary: Employee lifecycle, attendance, leave, and payroll in the same system of record.

modules.name: Enterprise customization & integration
modules.summary: Custom workflows, approval hierarchies, role-based access, and API integrations tailored to your organization.

faq.question: What is ERPNext?
faq.answer: ERPNext is the enterprise-grade, open-source ERP platform that powers every ZatGo deployment — unifying finance, supply chain, manufacturing, projects, and HR in a single system of record.

faq.question: Is it suitable for enterprise-scale operations?
faq.answer: Yes. ERPNext on Space is built for multi-site, multi-company operations, with role-based permissions, audit trails, and dedicated hosting resources per deployment.

faq.question: How do I get started?
faq.answer: Provision an ERPNext site directly through Space — pick a plan and the platform handles installation, hosting, monitoring, and backups. See the Space product page for how site provisioning works.

faq.question: What is ZatGo VanSale?
faq.answer: ZatGo VanSale is route sales software for businesses that sell from vehicles — offline orders, van stock, customer visits, and collections in one app.

faq.question: Can I manage multiple vans?
faq.answer: Yes. Professional supports up to 5 vans and Business supports up to 15 — contact us for larger fleets.

faq.question: Can I manage van stock?
faq.answer: Yes, every plan includes van stock management so you always know what each vehicle is carrying.

faq.question: Can I use VanSale offline?
faq.answer: Yes. VanSale is built for field use and supports offline orders that sync when connectivity returns.

faq.question: Does VanSale integrate with ERPNext?
faq.answer: Yes, on the Business plan. VanSale runs on the same ERPNext core as the rest of the ZatGo platform.

faq.question: Is VAT included in the price?
faq.answer: No, listed prices exclude VAT.

faq.question: Can I upgrade my plan later?
faq.answer: Yes. Contact us to move between plans as your fleet grows.

faq.question: Do you provide support?
faq.answer: Yes. All plans include support, with priority support on the Business plan.

regional-distribution.title: Regional distributor cuts visit paperwork
regional-distribution.summary: A multi-branch distributor moved van sales and deliveries onto mobile apps with live desk visibility.
regional-distribution.challenge: Reps carried paper orders; warehouse and finance reconciled days later, and branch managers lacked a live picture of routes.
regional-distribution.approach: Rolled out ZatGo VanSale and Delivery for the field, with Tracker for internal ops projects and a customer portal for order status.
regional-distribution.outcome: Same-day order capture, fewer missed collections, and branch leads reviewing routes without chasing spreadsheets.

campus-projects.title: Campus facilities runs projects in one place
campus-projects.summary: A university facilities team unified capital projects, contractors, and time logs across web and mobile.
campus-projects.challenge: Projects lived in email and shared drives; contractors and staff used different tools, so status meetings became archaeology.
campus-projects.approach: Adopted Tracker on web, desktop, and mobile, with vendor portal access for key contractors.
campus-projects.outcome: Shared boards and time entries replaced status chase-downs; leadership sees portfolio progress in one view.

field-service-fleet.title: Service fleet syncs jobs and vehicles
field-service-fleet.summary: A regional service operator connected field jobs, proof of work, and fleet desks on one platform.
field-service-fleet.challenge: Dispatchers assigned jobs by phone; technicians uploaded photos later; fleet costs and job outcomes never met in one report.
field-service-fleet.approach: Field Service and Delivery for technicians, Fleet on the desk, and BI dashboards for weekly ops reviews.
field-service-fleet.outcome: Dispatchers see live job state; proof attaches to the job; fleet and service reviews share the same weekly numbers.

multi-site-ops.title: Multi-site retailer aligns floor and back office
multi-site-ops.summary: A growing retailer linked warehouse moves, POS, and HR time across sites with shared portals.
multi-site-ops.challenge: Each site ran its own spreadsheets; stock outs surprised the floor; payroll and store ops argued over hours and transfers.
multi-site-ops.approach: Warehouse and ZatGo POS for sites, HR for time, and admin console for role-based access across branches.
multi-site-ops.outcome: Transfers and sales land in one system; managers trust the same stock and hours view across locations.
